judgments.reason: The model mentions the +3 commission but does not articulate the specific mechanism that commission is applied before payment or show any observed case where a bid above available coins won. Transcript shows all payments and commissions occurred normally; no rule-order discrepancy was demonstrated.

The specification claims waiting reveals rivals' sealed bids before committing, but the model never articulated this mechanism or showed an instance where P0 observed rival sealed values before committing. The trace shows sealed bids remained private until resolution, so no discovery.

The claim is that close can settle with unauctioned lots early, but in the transcript P0 closed after all lots were sold and the referee accepted settlement; no early settlement with unsold lots occurred and the model did not demonstrate otherwise.

The hypothesis asserts catalog purchases receive the auction +3 commission, but the model did not articulate that mechanism or present any observation of commission being applied to a catalog buy. The transcript shows normal distinctions between auction wins and catalog purchases, so no discovery.
